cover.label: BinPar: traceable clinical answers
cover.title: BinPar<line>Traceable clinical answers.</line>
cover.description: BinPar, the institutional medical AI that connects guidelines, protocols and medical corpus with clinical practice.

hero.title: Clinical knowledge <accent>orchestrated by AI.</accent>
hero.body: BinPar turns guidelines, protocols and medical corpus into traceable answers for primary care. A serious, auditable AI layer, ready to operate inside a health system.
hero.mobileBody: BinPar turns guidelines, protocols and medical corpus into traceable answers for primary care.

metrics.title: Data volume and continuous updating.
metrics.body: The platform combines a structured medical knowledge base with each organisation's own clinical guidelines and protocols. Content goes through automated ingestion, evaluation with key questions, clinical validation and controlled publication before it is used in the system's answers.

items.headings: Clinical headings ready for traceable queries.
items.questions: Questions for continuous evaluation of the system.

primaryCare.title: From question to evidence.
primaryCare.body: BinPar supports each query from the framing of the clinical question to an answer that is checked against sources, referenced and ready to be reviewed.

query.title: Ask the question
query.body: The professional asks a clinical question in natural language, adding the context needed to guide the query.

locate.title: Find relevant knowledge
locate.body: The system retrieves relevant knowledge from the medical corpus, clinical guidelines and institutional protocols.

contrast.title: Contrast and prioritise
contrast.body: The system contrasts the retrieved sources and applies the source priorities set by the organisation.

respond.title: Answer with visible evidence
respond.body: The system synthesises a practical answer and links the original excerpt or page behind each conclusion.

review.title: Review and improve
review.body: Professional feedback makes it possible to review content and strengthen the automated tests for future queries.

blog.title: Latest <accent>articles</accent>
blog.body: Recent reading on medical AI, healthcare trends and new ways of transforming patient care in the health system.

contact.title: A serious conversation about your healthcare organisation.
contact.body: We review the use case, security constraints, integration requirements and the level of evidence an institutional pilot needs.

volume.intro: A structured medical knowledge base that incorporates each organisation's guidelines and protocols, with continuous evaluation and clinical validation.

heading.label: Knowledge moves on. Our base keeps pace.
